onboarding.title: New here? Start with the beginner tutorial
onboarding.copy: BlockWar will create a 1v2 bot practice room at 1x speed with fog of war disabled, so you can learn movement, expansion, and capturing the enemy king.

tutorialSetup.title: Before you start, take these 3 quick steps

objective.label: First, the goal
objective.title: Capture one enemy king early
objective.copy: You do not need to learn every rule upfront. The fast aha moment is feeling how the map swings once you take an enemy crown.
objective.highlightValue: When you capture an enemy crown tile, their entire territory becomes yours instantly.

practiceRoom.label: Then, the setup
practiceRoom.title: This room is a light practice match
practiceRoom.copy: BlockWar will add 2 bots for you, keep the pace at 1x speed, and let you focus on movement, expansion, and your first king capture.
practiceRoom.note: Normal matches enable fog of war by default. The tutorial turns it off first so you can learn with less noise.

firstMoves.label: Finally, your opening
firstMoves.title: Follow the top guide after the match begins
firstMoves.copy: Once the match starts, do just three things: return to your king, expand outward, then look for your first enemy crown capture.
firstMoves.note: Especially G: if you lose track of your position, one tap brings you straight back to your own king.

tutorialGuide.cityHint: Cities keep producing units and are the best neutral resources to capture while expanding.
tutorialGuide.fogHint: Tutorial matches reveal the enemy king to help you practice tempo; normal matches require scouting through fog of war.
tutorialGuide.keyGHint: Press G to jump back to your king whenever you lose your bearings.

select_general.title: Select your king first
select_general.copy: Click the crown tile, or press G to jump back to your king. Every move starts from a tile you own.

expand_frontier.title: Expand to adjacent tiles
expand_frontier.copy: Use WASD, arrow keys, mouse clicks, or mobile drag to move into a neighboring tile. Spread out early so your army can grow.

split_army.title: Try a half-army move
split_army.copy: Press Z to send 50% of a stack, then move again. Splitting lets you keep strength behind while expanding.

hunt_king.title: Attack the enemy king
hunt_king.copy: Keep advancing and capture the enemy crown tile. Once you take their king, their territory becomes yours.

howToPlay.title: How to Play
howToPlay.goal: Your goal is to capture other generals
howToPlay.plains: Plains produce one unit every 25 turns, expand your territory as much as possible!
howToPlay.cities: Cities and generals produce one unit every turn
howToPlay.moves: You can move twice per turn.
howToPlay.capture: When you capture the enemy general, all his territory belongs to you and his army strength is halved and becomes yours.
howToPlay.how-to-toggle-50: Z / Click Twice / Mobile: Quick Double Touch
howToPlay.wsad: WSAD / ArrowKey / MouseClick / TouchDrag on Mobile
howToPlay.beginnerTutorial: If this is your first match, start from Beginner Tutorial in the lobby. It disables fog and adds 2 bots for practice; normal rooms enable fog by default.
